Definition: from G5259 and G4766; to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet):--spread.
BiblicalUsage: hypostrṓnnymi is how Scripture says to spread underneath, to strew. In Luke 19:36, the text says "they spread their clothes in the way."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hypostrṓnnymi means to spread underneath, to strew, and I leave it at that.
